channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Woman jailed for smuggling arsenal of military-grade weapons
item.description: A woman who smuggled a cache of firearms, ammunition and heroin into the UK has been jailed for nine years following an investigation by the National Crime Agency. The post Woman jailed for smuggling arsenal of military-grade weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US tests unarmed nuclear missile over Pacific Ocean
item.description: The United States Air Force has conducted a test launch of an unarmed Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile equipped with two test re-entry vehicles as part of routine efforts to verify the reliability of the system. The post US tests unarmed nuclear missile over Pacific Ocean first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK considers expanding the use of sythentic training
item.description: The proposed Gladiator and Spartan Core Systems and Services contract would support the MOD Gladiator distributed training system while also enabling the Royal Navy’s developing SPARTAN programme for maritime collective training. The post UK considers expanding the use of sythentic training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO concludes major submarine warfare exercise
item.description: NATO has concluded its largest annual anti-submarine warfare exercise, Dynamic Manta 2026, after a period of multinational training in the central Mediterranean Sea aimed at strengthening the Alliance’s ability to detect and counter submarine threats. The post NATO concludes major submarine warfare exercise first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Why Ferguson Marine is turning a corner
item.description: Work on structural sections for Royal Navy Type 26 frigates, alongside plans for new vessels serving Scotland, is helping anchor Ferguson Marine's recovery as the Port Glasgow yard rebuilds its role within the shipbuilding industry. The post Why Ferguson Marine is turning a corner first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE Systems delivers 100,000th APKWS guidance kit
item.description: BAE Systems has delivered its 100,000th Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System (APKWS) laser-guidance kit, a production milestone for the widely used precision-strike system. The post BAE Systems delivers 100,000th APKWS guidance kit first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD to award intelligence data deal to Janes
item.description: The Ministry of Defence plans to award a contract worth up to GBP 17.5 million to Janes for access to defence intelligence databases and analytical tools. The post MOD to award intelligence data deal to Janes first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British forces intercept Iranian one-way attack drone
item.description: British military forces have intercepted a one-way attack drone launched from Iran towards Iraq, according to the Ministry of Defence. The post British forces intercept Iranian one-way attack drone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Hull man charged with terrorism offences after police probe
item.description: A 23-year-old man from Hull has been charged with multiple terrorism offences following an investigation by Counter Terrorism Policing North East supported by Humberside Police. The post Hull man charged with terrorism offences after police probe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scottish Ambulance Service highlights reservist support
item.description: The Scottish Ambulance Service illustrates a model where support is delivered through practical arrangements and organisational culture rather than through comprehensive workforce monitoring. The post Scottish Ambulance Service highlights reservist support first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
